Lean.Level.succ.description: A function that increments a given level to produce the next higher level.

Lean.Level.zero.description: A constant representing the base level in a hierarchy of levels.

Lean.Level.param.description: A function that associates a given name with its corresponding parameter level in a level hierarchy.

Lean.levelZero.description: A constant representing the lowest level in a level hierarchy.

Lean.Level.max.description: A function that computes the maximum of two levels within a level hierarchy.

Lean.Level.imax.description: A function that determines the greatest level between two levels in a level hierarchy.

Lean.Level.mvar.description: A function that associates a level with a given mutable variable identifier in a level hierarchy.
